ko.label: 성 안에서 함께
spiritReply: 손을 내밀자 작은 빛이 가까이 다가왔어요.
작은 빛이 한 바퀴 돌고 다시 곁에 머물렀어요.
ko.seasonHint: 비석을 눌러 계절의 기운을 느껴 보세요.

night.pawn: 오늘 모은 장작으로 밤을 버틸 수 있겠지?
night.boy: 할아버지는 안에서 쉬고 계셔. 우리도 불 곁에 앉자.
night.girl: 나무는 다 옮겼어. 이제 성 안에 있을게.
night.guardian: 문은 내가 지킬게. 넌 따뜻한 곳에 있어.
night.mage: 불이 꺼지지 않게 보고 있어. 손을 녹이고 가.
night.duelist: 발소리가 들리면 알려 줘. 같이 보고 있자.

en.label: Company in the courtyard
en.spiritHint: A little light is waiting beside you.
spiritReply: The little light drew closer to your outstretched hand.
The spirit circled your fingertips with a soft glow.
The little light turned once, then settled beside you.
en.residentHint: Who would you like to greet?
en.seasonHint: Touch a waystone to feel its season.

night.pawn: Will today's firewood last us through the night?
night.boy: Grandpa's resting inside. Let's sit by the fire too.
night.girl: All the wood's brought in. I'll stay inside now.
night.guardian: I'll guard the gate. Stay somewhere warm.
night.mage: I'm keeping the fire going. Warm your hands before you go.
night.berserker: Sounds restless out there. My sword's ready.
night.duelist: Tell me if you hear footsteps. We'll keep watch together.
night.dark-knight: Even on a long night, you're not alone here.

spring.name: Spring
spring.hint: Petals drift on a warm breeze.

summer.name: Summer
summer.hint: Warm golden light fills the courtyard.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.hint: Leaves settle slowly on the stone path.

winter.name: Winter
winter.hint: Small snowflakes fall in the quiet courtyard.

ja.label: 城の仲間たち
ja.spiritHint: 小さな光が、そばで待っています。
spiritReply: 手を差し出すと、小さな光が近づいてきました。
精霊が指先を巡り、やわらかく輝きました。
小さな光はひと回りして、またそばに留まりました。
ja.residentHint: 誰に挨拶しましょうか。
ja.seasonHint: 石碑に触れて、季節の気配を感じてみましょう。

night.pawn: 今日集めた薪で、夜を越せるかな？
night.boy: おじいちゃんは中で休んでるよ。僕たちも火のそばに座ろう。
night.girl: 薪は全部運んだよ。あとは城の中にいるね。
night.guardian: 門は私が守る。暖かい場所にいて。
night.mage: 火が消えないように見ているよ。手を温めていって。
night.berserker: 外が騒がしいな。剣の用意はできている。
night.duelist: 足音が聞こえたら教えてくれ。一緒に見張ろう。
night.dark-knight: 夜が長くても、ここでは一人じゃないよ。

spring.name: 春
spring.hint: 暖かな風に、花びらが舞います。

summer.name: 夏
summer.hint: 暖かな金色の光が、城の中庭を包みます。

autumn.name: 秋
autumn.hint: 石畳に、落ち葉がゆっくり降り積もります。

winter.name: 冬
winter.hint: 静かな中庭に、小さな雪が舞い降ります。
